query:
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_labels l WHERE l.link_id=$1 AND l.provider_label_id=$2 AND l.type='User'
            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_settings_work w WHERE w.link_id=l.link_id AND w.kind='delete_label' AND w.resource_key=l.provider_label_id AND w.completed_revision<w.revision)) AS "available!"
